decisionDescription: Evening sessions launched for an 8-week pilot.
organiserExplanation: Recurring student feedback highlighted access barriers during daytime slots.

decisionDescription: A laptop loan scheme was launched in February 2026, with 40 devices available for up to 2-week borrowing periods. Extended VPN access has also been confirmed for all enrolled students through the end of the academic year.
organiserExplanation: Student responses consistently identified device access and off-campus connectivity as the top barriers to remote learning. The loan scheme and VPN extension directly address the most-cited issues. Lecture recording retention has been extended to 12 weeks following feedback about revision access.
